title: Microbial community involved in the dyeing wastewater treatment process using microbial fuel cells
description: This study investigated the microbial community in Microbial fuel cells (MFC). Two reactors were operated with either starch or ethanol as the carbon source: one with sludge-only inoculated anodes (MFCS) and one with magnetite-preinoculated anodes (MFCM). Microbial communities were analyzed from the anode biofilms of both MFCS and MFCM reactors.
